text:
Riches
I have my
		faithful joy
and my lost joy:
one like a rose,
the other like a thorn.
What they stole from me,
I was not dispossessed of:

		I have my faithful joy
and my lost joy,
and I am rich in purple

		and melancholy.
Ah, how loving is the rose
and how beloved the thorn!

		Like the double outline

of twin fruits,
I have my faithful joy
and my
		lost one....

translation.title: 2nd. This Long Weariness...
